claim: Patchline ships a cross-language hazard atlas comparing prevalence across ORMs and engines with confidence intervals. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the cross-language hazard atlas claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make cross-language-hazard-atlas-gate`.
